import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    s, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    size = 1
    while size < s:
        size <<= 1
    # key = count * 2^20 + index, so the minimum key is the least busy, lowest-numbered server
    inf = 1 << 62
    t = [inf] * (2 * size)
    t[size:size + s] = range(s)
    for i in range(size - 1, 0, -1):
        a, b = t[2 * i], t[2 * i + 1]
        t[i] = a if a < b else b
    step = 1 << 20
    mask = step - 1
    out = []
    for k in range(n):
        lo = size
        hi = size + int(data[2 + k]) + 1
        best = inf
        while lo < hi:
            if lo & 1:
                v = t[lo]
                if v < best:
                    best = v
                lo += 1
            if hi & 1:
                hi -= 1
                v = t[hi]
                if v < best:
                    best = v
            lo >>= 1
            hi >>= 1
        idx = best & mask
        p = size + idx
        v = t[p] + step
        t[p] = v
        p >>= 1
        while p:
            a, b = t[2 * p], t[2 * p + 1]
            m = a if a < b else b
            if t[p] == m:
                break
            t[p] = m
            p >>= 1
        out.append(idx)
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, out)) + '\n')


main()
